# Confluent

> Confluent is the data streaming platform that enables organizations to build real-time data products and intelligent applications powered by Apache Kafka, Flink, and AI.

Confluent provides a complete ecosystem for data in motion, combining fully managed cloud services with enterprise governance, stream processing, connectors, and AI-powered streaming agents. The platform serves technical practitioners, executives, and enterprises seeking to transform data into actionable insights.

## Key Topics

- Apache Kafka
- Data Streaming
- Confluent Cloud

- Confluent Connectors

## Deployment Options

- [Confluent Cloud, a Fully Managed Apache Kafka® Service](https://www.confluent.io/confluent-cloud): Confluent Cloud fully managed Kafka service with autoscaling
- [Confluent Platform: Deploy and Operate Apache Kafka® Anywhere](https://www.confluent.io/product/confluent-platform): Confluent Platform for self-managed Kafka deployment and operations
- [Confluent Private Cloud | Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/product/confluent-private-cloud): Confluent Private Cloud for secure self-managed Kafka infrastructure

## Capabilities & Features

- [Easily Connect Data Systems in Real Time With Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/product/confluent-connectors): Confluent Connectors for real-time data integration across systems
- [Enterprise-Grade Stream Governance for Apache Kafka](https://www.confluent.io/product/stream-governance): Stream governance with schema registry and data quality for Kafka
- [Stream Processing for Analytics and AI on Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/product/flink): Apache Flink stream processing for analytics and AI on Confluent
- [Confluent Intelligence: Real-Time AI With Apache Kafka® and Apache Flink®](https://www.confluent.io/product/confluent-intelligence): Confluent Intelligence for real-time AI with Kafka and Flink
- [Streaming Agents on Confluent Cloud | Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/product/streaming-agents): Event-driven streaming agents for intelligent automation on Confluent
- [Tableflow: Convert Kafka topics to Iceberg and Delta tables | Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/product/tableflow): Tableflow converts Kafka data to Iceberg and Delta Lake tables
